Writing tip: Writing About Cause and Effect

What makes something happen is called a cause. An effect is what happens as a result of the cause.

The purpose of cause and effect is to:
To discuss the reasons why something occurs
To discuss the results of an event, feeling or action
I was feeling kind of sluggish so I decided to try something new.

You use cohesive devices and linking words to express and join ideas.
Here are some words you can use in your writing to express cause and effect.

Writing Tip: Unreal Conditional, Exceptions with I were

You use the unreal conditional to talk about unreal,  impossible or improbable situations. It provides an imaginary result for a given situation. It is very unlikely that the condition will be fulfilled.
If you were interested, I would be happy to send you some of the recipes we used over the weekend.
In written English, you use were in the Present Unreal Conditional. The form was is not considered grammatically correct.
In everyday conversations, was is often used.
You use was even if the pronoun is I, he, she or it.
If I were you, I wouldn't show them to Vanessa.
If you weren't in shock by now I would be surprised.
If I were Amy, I would be a little hesitant.

images.text:
Hey John,
What's up? I saw Instapic photos of you at that party last weekend. Man, you know how to have a good time. When are you gonna settle down and get a real job? If I were you, I wouldn't show them to Vanessa. She's overstretched at work. Anyway, thought I would fill you in on Cambridge gossip. I'm turning vegan! That might be a slight overstatement but after cooking vegan meals with Vanessa and Amy over the weekend, I can honestly say that I'm considering a life change. I was feeling kind of sluggish so I decided to try something new. I'm choosing to take my health seriously since Amy and Vanessa made me more aware of the dangers of sugar and refined foods.

Essentially, vegan means no meat, eggs, dairy products or anything else derived from animals. My diet would include grains, beans, legumes, vegetables and fruits. No more meat-lovers pizza or barbecue chicken wings for me!  I can only imagine the look on your face. If you weren't in shock by now I would be surprised. I think one of the main reasons I'm prepared to start this new health kick is because I have their support. They seem to know what they're talking about and can put up with my ignorance.

Added to that, I've started a cleanse to rid my body of toxins. There is no point in embarking on new eating habits if I am not starting with a clean slate. Remember, if I had your metabolism, I wouldn't work so hard on staying fit.If you were interested, I would be happy to send you some of the recipes we used over the weekend. They were actually pretty tasty and I'm not just saying that because I made them and they were delicious!
Your buddy,
Pete
